_doc: L3-BN Phase-2 confirmatory cell selection. Locked before running confirmatory seeds (pre-reg §3.3). Selection computed from frozen Phase-1 exploratory data (3 seeds/cell).
selection_rule: Keystone = mean-field vs sampled paired contrast within the B5 generator. Breadth = highest-mean-stage3 (=consistency) sampled cell from each mechanistically-distinct informative family (B4 state-dep-k, T local-minibatch, C1 pairwise). C2-uniform excluded as degenerate (x_local==x_global). g1 cells in other families excluded unless verified mean-field.

classifier_lock.L3_iff: cycle_level==3 == stage1 & stage2 & stage3 all pass
classifier_lock.stage3_score_is: consistency = fraction of consecutive phase-space turning crosses agreeing with net rotation sign; 0.50 = chance (no directional bias)
classifier_lock.corr_threshold_note: Gates Stage 2 (L1->L2) only. ALL confirmatory cells already clear Stage 2 (every run is L2 or L3), so corr_threshold is NON-BINDING for the L2->L3 question this paper concerns; locked at the personality-dungeon L2-lineage convention 0.09.
classifier_lock.eta_anchor: eta=0.55 confirmed by paper_draft_v1 seed45 consistency=0.5611 being classified L3 (would fail at eta=0.6).
classifier_lock.phase_input: strategy weight series w_* (not proportions p_*)

arm_A_positive_control_meanfield.seed_expansion: NOT NEEDED (deterministic: seeds 45/47/49 are byte-identical). Reproducibility instead shown across delta in {0.000,0.003,0.006,0.010,0.015}, all consistency=1.0000, all L3.
arm_A_positive_control_meanfield.role: Confirms rotational L3 structure EXISTS in the continuous limit -> the negative result is a discretization effect, not a missing-structure effect.

arm_B_sampled_treatments_expand_to_10_se.role: KEYSTONE paired contrast: identical generator to arm A, only mean-field -> sampled differs.
Closest sampled approach to the eta=0.55 bar anywhere in Phase 1 (best-hope structural patch).
The ONLY valid test of local replicator dynamics (random init breaks C2 degeneracy); forms phase domains (batch_phase_spread~1.55 rad) yet consistency stays at chance.
Over-homogenization branch (imitation -> consensus faster than well-mixed); highest-mean C1 cell.

excluded.c2_uniform_init_all_cells: Degenerate: uniform w_i(0) => x_local==x_global => g_local==g_global identically (cosine_vs_global=1.000, batch_phase_spread=0.000). Not a valid local-replicator test; reported only as a methodological cautionary note.
excluded.g1_mean_field_other_families: Only the B5 g1_mean_field is used as positive control; verified deterministic (seed-identical) and L3 (consistency=1.0).

seeds.note: Consecutive integers to avoid cherry-picking; same seed set used for each sampled cell and its paired control.
